info.title: MisarPost Actions
info.description: Plan, generate, schedule and repurpose posts across every connected channel, and track what performs — from any AI assistant.

post.description: List the user's active connected social accounts with their account ID, platform and display name. Call this before scheduling: schedule_post needs the connected_account_id, and a post can only go to an account that is connected and active.

result.description: The tool's output — text or JSON.

402.description: Plan limit — the body carries code: plan_limit_exceeded and an upgrade offer

429.description: Rate limited, or a quota block carrying code: plan_limit_exceeded

Optionally only posts with one tag. Needs a plan that includes the content calendar; otherwise it returns an

post.description: Schedule a post to ONE connected account at a given time, or publish it immediately with scheduled_at="now". This queues real content for a real audience — show the user the exact text, account and time and get explicit approval first. To post the same content to several accounts, call once per acco

platform.description: Platform of that connected account (must match it).

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone (e.g. 2030-01-01T09:00:00Z), or "now" to publish immediately.

media_urls.description: Up to 10 publicly reachable media URLs to attach.

first_comment.description: Optional first comment posted under the post (max 2200 characters).

variant_id.description: UUID of the draft (from list_drafts or generate_posts) this post was made from; marks that draft as scheduled.

platform_meta.description: Platform-specific publish settings, passed through to the publisher. Examples: Reddit { subreddit, flairId }, Pinterest { board }, Discord/Slack { channelId }, YouTube { title, privacyStatus }, Hashnode/Medium { publicationId }, Listmonk { listId, templateId }, Lemmy { communityId }, Skool { groupId }. Look up valid ids with list_publish_options.

tag_ids.description: Up to 20 post tag UUIDs to apply.

post_batch_id.description: UUID shared by every call that posts the same content to different accounts, so they can later be managed together.

result.description: The tool's output — text or JSON.

post.description: Edit a post that has not gone out yet (status pending, queued or draft): its text, its scheduled time, its first comment, or its tags. Changing the time moves when it publishes, so confirm the new text and time with the user first. Published posts cannot be edited.

post_id.description: Post UUID — from list_posts or get_calendar.

scheduled_at.description: New ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. 2030-01-01T09:00:00+05:30.

first_comment.description: New first comment, or null to remove it.

tag_ids.description: Replace the post's tags with these post tag UUIDs (max 20); [] removes all.
